summary: Verified the fix for the empty SGP Scanner (OddsBlaze key was rejected). Backend: GET /api/scanner/board?ra=8&game=26NOV02CHIPHI returned 200 with books={enabled:true, sgp:true, sgp_key_rejected:false}, and its players had integer SGP prices from dk, fan and hr (for example LeBron James dk 350, fan 310, hr 382). 2/2 pytest passed. Frontend (2 full scans only): scanning with the 8+ reb & 8+ ast filter showed 12 rows ('12 of 17 combos across 15 games') with DraftKings, Fanatics, BetMGM and Hard Rock SGP prices and EV values (+372.4% down to +13.0%). The default 10+ pts triple-double scan showed 1 row (Luka Doncic, FD/DK triple-double odds plus all 5 SGP books, EV +36.6%). The sgp-key-warning banner did not appear in either scan, and there were no page errors. The '1 of 5' and '12 of 17' counts are not a bug: the 60 existing user bets include those combos, and tracked plays are hidden from the board on purpose.

issues: Slate-card combo counts include combos the user already tracked, which are hidden from the board (e.g. CHI-PHI card says '1 combo' but the TD10 board has no CHI-PHI row). This could confuse users; consider counting only the rows that are shown.

action_items: Optional: make the slate-card counts use the shown rows (with tracked plays excluded) instead of all rows
critical_code_review_comments: oddsblaze.status['key_rejected'] is only updated when _book_props actually fetches; cached prop hits (120s TTL) keep the old flag. This is acceptable, but if the key is rotated the flag can lag by up to 2 minutes.
The flag is a single global for all books, so the last book's response wins. A 401 from one book followed by a 200 from another clears it. Consider any() across books per refresh.
If ODDSBLAZE_API_KEY is missing entirely, sgp is false but no warning is shown; the banner only covers a rejected key.
Carried over: scanner_game's book-only sort can call min() with no default.
